# RX Clinic

> RX Clinic is Arabic-first clinic management software from Faya Dev LTD for doctors and clinic reception teams in Iraq. It brings patient files, appointments, waiting queues, prescriptions, finances, and dental workflows into one web application.

Canonical website: https://rx.faya.dev
Primary language: Arabic (Iraq)
Secondary language: English
Publisher: Faya Dev LTD

## Core product pages

- [Clinic management software in Iraq](https://rx.faya.dev/solutions/clinic-management-software-iraq): Product overview, pricing, trial, workflows, and FAQs.
- [Dental clinic software](https://rx.faya.dev/solutions/dental-clinic-software): Dental charting, treatment plans, appointments, and payments.
- [Patient management](https://rx.faya.dev/features/patient-management): Patient files, history, search, and flexible fields.
- [Appointment management](https://rx.faya.dev/features/appointment-management): Calendar, waiting queue, attendance states, and staff coordination.
- [Electronic prescriptions](https://rx.faya.dev/features/electronic-prescriptions): Create, save, review, and print prescriptions.

## Verified commercial facts

- Free trial: 14 days, no payment card required.
- Annual subscription: 160,000 Iraqi dinars.
- Setup and training: included.
- Secretary account: included.
- Supported devices: modern phone and computer browsers.
